# VectorCraft Use
## Plugin marketplaces
This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.
| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| Full-stack development | Full Stack Plugins | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, qual

ity checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | Full
AIGC Plugins | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |
> Turn a brand brief into an editable native VectorCraft project — logo, icon set, infographic or ch
art — and revise it object by object instead of re-drawing it.
English | 简体中文 · Install · Quick start · Skills · Troubleshooting
## Positioning
`vectorcraft` connects a coding agent to the real VectorCraft engine, so a task ends with a native `
.vectorcraft` project you can reopen and keep editing, not just a flattened picture. The plugin owns
workflow skills, a pinned first-use CLI installer, and a same-session editor bridge; it does not re
-implement the editor, the renderer, or the file format.

-

raft-cli` into your user data directory; nothing is written to `PATH` and `sudo` is not used.
- Netw
ork access on the first editor launch. The plugin downloads and verifies the pinned editor archive;
a complete release ZIP already contains it, and no Rust toolchain or `npm install` is needed.

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Logo system with mono and
reversed variants | `vectorcraft-logo-system`, `vectorcraft-cli-artboards` | Native artboards, one p

er variant, with distinct IDs |
| Consistent icon set | `vectorcraft-icon-set`, `vectorcraft-cli-sha

pes` | Icons on named artboards, editable paths |
| Infographic for a process or dataset | `vectorcr
aft-infographic`, `vectorcraft-editable-chart` | Live text and `create_graph` charts, not baked imag

es |
| Trace a bitmap back to vectors | `vectorcraft-trace-artwork`, `vectorcraft-cli-paths` | Rebui

lt paths plus the original as a reference layer |
| Clipped illustration and sticker sheets | `vecto
rcraft-clipped-illustration`, `vectorcraft-sticker-grid`, `vectorcraft-sticker-offset-border` | Rele

asable clipping groups, resizable arrays, offset outlines |
| Recolor a brand without touching neigh
bours | `vectorcraft-cli-appearance`, `vectorcraft-cli-selection` | Changed bound variants, unchange

d unrelated objects |
| Multi-artboard delivery | `vectorcraft-cli-export` + `export` tool | SVG, PD
F, raster or template output per artboard range |
The plugin never rewrites the upstream editor and never silently changes a deliverable format. Raste
rized effects are reported instead of being hidden.

## Architecture and security
Agent ↔ plugin traffic is stdio MCP. The browser bridge listens on `127.0.0.1` only, with a random t
oken and Host/Origin checks; workspace escapes are rejected, downloads are verified by SHA-256 befor
e use, and the bundled editor is always kept as a fallback. Skills are instructions and do not enfor
ce policy at runtime. The plugin stores no account or API credential, and the authors do not receive
